summary: npm package ships only a Cloudflare-lookalike HTML redirect page
details: Package contains a single index.html file declared as main. The HTML impersonates a Cloudflare Turnstile 'Just a moment...' verification page (sitekey 0x4AAAAAADrvn4rDM7WVvgPh) and includes an inline script that reconstructs a redirect target from an obfuscated string array (_0x522c) plus URL query parameters, then assigns window.location to that URL. There is no package.json lifecycle script, no JavaScript main, and no code that runs when the package is installed or required in Node; requiring an HTML file is a no-op. The artifact appears to be phishing/redirect content hosted on npm rather than code that attacks developers who install it.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
